note: Instructions, 11 statements and the (True)/(False) keys transcribed verbatim from the study's own CC BY S1 Appendix; '1.'..'11.' numbering stripped, and the trailing '(True)'/'(False)' moved from each statement into correct_response. DEVIATION: the appendix's parenthetical '(1=correct; 0=incorrect)' was dropped from instructions, because it describes the authors' SCORED variable, not the stored response: the live table (data/enders_2022_conspiracy_vaccine.py melts Raw Data.csv SCILIT_1..11 unchanged, codes = Qualtrics column names) holds the respondent's true/false CHOICE, which Analyses.do converts to correctness item by item (e.g. 'replace correct2 = 1 if scilit_2 == 0'). option_text 'True' (resp 1) / 'False' (resp 0): the source prints no option labels; the words are taken from the stem ('true or false?'), and the direction from Analyses.do, which scores scilit_k==1 correct for exactly the six (True)-keyed statements. The data agree: under 1=True every item scores 47.5-88.8% correct, the flip would put 'The center of the Earth is very hot' at 12.4%. correct_response holds the option label ('True'/'False'), as roar_lexical does; key_source=source_published (the appendix's own key). Mapping: codes carry no text in the deposit (no question-text row, no codebook, .dta labels repeat names); alignment is the appendix's printed order. Checked: the appendix T/F pattern TFTTFTFFTTF equals the do-file's code-by-code keying of scilit_1..11; the six True-keyed codes are exactly the six with highest P(resp=1), the unique best of 462 true/false class assignments (7.730 vs runner-up 7.604); all 11 corrected item-rest r positive (.046-.241). Order WITHIN each class is not tested (sibling enders_2022_conspiracy_thinking found this appendix's ACTS order did not match the data, so appendix order is not assumed infallible). Live n 2048-2053 per item; 1-count per item equals Raw Data.csv. Rights: NISTEP/NSF-style public-understanding-of-science knowledge items, printed in the study's CC BY appendix; no instrument_rights_register.csv row applies and no fee/permission/NC/ND/no-redistribution clause located to quote; extracted normally, no register row written.
public_note: The survey stored each respondent's true/false answer, not whether it was correct: resp 1 means the respondent said 'True', and correct_response gives the published key; items are matched to codes by the appendix's order, which the data confirm for true- vs false-keyed statements but cannot check within each group
